LanguageData.RR_Anomaly_PresenceText: Somebody in the space heard something move in a room nobody was in. There is nothing there now. Nothing has changed and nothing is required.
LanguageData.RR_Anomaly_LightsText: Every light in the space has switched itself off. The switches still work - somebody just has to walk over and turn them back on.
LanguageData.RR_Anomaly_ColdText: The space has dropped several degrees with no source anyone can find. Warm clothing, a heater, or leaving will all answer it.
LanguageData.RR_Anomaly_SeepageText: The place is filthier than it was an hour ago, and nobody tracked it in. Cleaning works here the same as anywhere else.
LanguageData.RR_Anomaly_MovedText: Loose things in the space are not where they were left. Nothing is missing - it is all still here, somewhere else.
LanguageData.RR_Anomaly_DeepColdText: The space has gone badly cold, far more than before, and it does not feel like it will lift on its own. Get people warm or get them out.
LanguageData.RR_Anomaly_BlackoutText: Everything in the space went dark at once. The switches still work. Somebody will have to cross the dark to reach them.
